slides.reasoning: Both nail the near-black/lime system, but A's tighter metric row with rules and clearer labelled chart axis reads faster, whereas B strands its metric labels far right of their numerals creating awkward internal voids.

B fills the frame with a coherent illustrated route plus three supporting columns and a clean aubergine quote bar, while A leaves a large dead band beneath the curve and lets dotted marks tangle with the route line.
B's before/after panels carry real supporting visuals and a structured header, while A's two large panels are mostly empty inside and the ROI strip feels crowded against the CTA.
B honours the brief's restrained serif tone with an elegant orbital allocation wheel and hairline data rows, whereas A substitutes a bold sans headline with an awkward 'FOR THE' line break.
B makes the product the hero at keynote scale with annotated callouts and a decisive black price bar, while A's small photo sits in a visibly mismatched grey image box that breaks the silver field.
B delivers one calm, coherent chart system with clean variance annotations, while A's '103% of plan' label is struck through by the plan line — a clear collision.
B builds a genuine transit-map interchange with unambiguous pillar copy; A's four parallel bars mix two pillars' annotations into one text block and leave a large empty mid-slide gap.
A's gate labels are crossed by dashed lines and the Gate C text runs into its diamond, whereas B's phase band, gate boxes and launch ramp are cleanly separated and hierarchically ordered.
B's loop, worked example and practice rule are balanced across the full canvas, while A doubles its quotation marks and leaves roughly a third of the slide empty at bottom right.
B's editorial serif headline, monumental 68% and handover diagram sit on a clear grid, while A's headline third line crowds the 68% figure and the mid-right area is left hollow.
B achieves the oversized back-of-auditorium scale with a genuine visible/hidden UI diagram; A's type is comparatively small and its two plain boxes plus stock silhouette read more like a brochure.
B composes four oversized metrics, the customer quote and three priorities into one confident spread, while A leaves the bottom third of the orange field completely empty.

B's corridor map is a true informational centrepiece with clean marginal data, whereas A's schematic collides '18,400 ha in restoration' with the '100 km' scale label and buries 'KARRI FOREST' on a dark shape.

B's baseline-grid layout, descriptive annotations and three genuinely different classification specimens are more instructional and better balanced than A's near-identical specimens and empty lower band.
A suffers broken letter-spacing in the partnership pills and an unfilled dashed segment in its audience bar, while B's collage, complete stacked bar and peach footer band are cleanly resolved.
